TABLE.NAME: local_h5pca_book
TABLE.COMMENT: Access policy configuration for an H5P activity

FIELD.NAME: cmid
FIELD.COMMENT: Course module ID for the H5P activity

FIELD.NAME: contentid
FIELD.COMMENT: Cached H5P content ID when available

FIELD.NAME: contenthash
FIELD.COMMENT: Cached hash identifying the H5P content

FIELD.NAME: manifesthash
FIELD.COMMENT: Hash of the most recently processed chapter manifest

FIELD.NAME: enabled
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether chapter access rules are enabled

FIELD.NAME: defaultmessage
FIELD.COMMENT: Default plain-text message for locked chapters

TABLE.NAME: local_h5pca_chapter
TABLE.COMMENT: Access policy configuration for a chapter in an H5P activity

FIELD.NAME: chapteruuid
FIELD.COMMENT: Stable subContentId or controlled legacy fallback ID

FIELD.NAME: titlecache
FIELD.COMMENT: Last title received in the chapter manifest

FIELD.NAME: positioncache
FIELD.COMMENT: Last position received in the chapter manifest

FIELD.NAME: stableid
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether chapteruuid is a stable subContentId

FIELD.NAME: accessmode
FIELD.COMMENT: Access mode: open, locked or conditional

FIELD.NAME: availabilityjson
FIELD.COMMENT: Future conditional availability definition in JSON

FIELD.NAME: lockedmessage
FIELD.COMMENT: Plain-text message shown while this chapter is locked

FIELD.NAME: showrestriction
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether the restriction explanation may be shown

FIELD.NAME: active
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether the chapter is present in the active manifest
